title: Institute of Health story
description: A pinned scroll story over full-bleed dark media. The stage holds the window for about five screens of scrolling while the background slowly scales up 1 → 1.3 and drifts down. Large white statements, line by line, rise out of a blur, hold, and rise away into a blur; in the last step a scatter of word tags floats in and out before the final statement settles. A thin ring at the top counts the steps and a row of hairline bars at the bottom fills one by one. Pure CSS scroll-driven animation.
notes: CSS only (animation-timeline); browsers without it, and reduced motion, get a plain section with the statements stacked over the background
text sits on dark media in every theme (highlight-foreground over a black scrim); the placeholder is a red radial gradient from highlight and glow
very tall on purpose (550svh) while the effect runs
